blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Agrarian Reform Secretary Conrado Estrella III is calling on all Filipinos, especially government officials, to unite against hunger by helping farmers produce more food, earn a decent living, and build more secure livelihoods for their families. “All together, let’s fight hunger. What I really want to fight is hunger,” Estrella said in a statement on Monday, urging officials to work together on the needs of farming communities. Estrella said efforts should focus on securing stable livelihoods for farmers and enough food for families rather than quarrelling with one another.
